items.known: CKV_AWS_5 Ensure all data stored in the Elasticsearch is securely encrypted at rest (resource aws_elasticsearch_domain.monitoring-framework)
items.remediation: Add an encrypt_at_rest block to aws_elasticsearch_domain.monitoring-framework with enabled = true.

scores.reason: Correctly names the encrypt_at_rest block with enabled = true, which satisfies CKV_AWS_5. It does not mention that ES 2.3 and t2.small don't support encryption at rest, but the check fix is right.
